scenes.name: CLASHING EXAMS
lines: Five exams. A line joins two that share a student, so they cannot sit at the same time.
五门考试。两门共有学生，就连一条线：它们不能排在同一时段。
Give each exam a time slot, and call the slot its color. Three slots are enough here.
给每门考试一个时段，把时段叫作它的颜色。这里三个时段就够了。
Two are not: A, B and E all clash with each other.
两个不够：A、B、E 两两冲突。

scenes.name: WHO GOES FIRST
lines: Now say it with arrows. For every clash, decide which exam goes first.
换一种说法，用箭头。每一处冲突，都定下谁先考。
Point each line from the earlier slot to the later one.
让每条线从早的时段指向晚的时段。
Follow the arrows and the slot moves later at every step, so a chain holds at most three exams.
顺着箭头走，每一步时段都往后推，所以一串箭头至多串起三门。
One longest chain is A, then B, then E: three exams.
最长的一串之一是 A、B、E：三门。
Flip one arrow, so D goes before A, and a chain runs through all five.
只把一支箭头反过来，让 D 先于 A，就有一串穿过全部五门。

scenes.name: BACK FROM ARROWS
lines: Now go backwards. Keep the good arrows and forget the slots.
现在倒过来走。留下好的那组箭头，忘掉时段。
For each exam, count the most steps you can still take along the arrows.
对每门考试，数一数顺着箭头最多还能走几步。
The counts are two, one, two, zero, zero.
Every arrow runs from a bigger count to a smaller one, so clashing exams never share a count.
每支箭头都从大数指向小数，所以冲突的两门，数永远不同。
Read three minus each count as a slot: a three-slot timetable again. Only D has moved, and nothing clashes.
把 3 减去步数当作时段，又是一张三时段考表：只有 D 换了时段，没有冲突。
The arrows already knew the timetable.
箭头里本来就藏着考表。

scenes.name: ANY FINITE GRAPH
lines: Lean checks the general rule, for any finite graph and any number k.
Lean 内核检验了一般规律：对任意有限图、任意 k 都成立。
It can be colored with k colors exactly when its lines can be given directions with no directed path longer than k vertices.
图可以用 k 种颜色着色，当且仅当能给它的线定向，使每条有向路至多 k 个顶点。
The arrows may even run both ways, or round in a circle. The proof first drops arrows until no circle is left.
箭头甚至可以双向，可以绕圈；证明先删去一些箭头，直到没有圈。
So the fewest colors you need equals the shortest you can make the longest chain.
所以，最少要几种颜色，就等于最长的一串箭头最短能压到几个顶点。

scenes.name: FIELD AND LINE
lines: This chapter reads a coloring as a field, a value on every vertex, and a directed path as a line.
本章把着色读作场：每个顶点上一个值；把有向路读作线。
Checking a coloring is easy: one look along each line, at its two ends.
验一张着色很容易：沿每条线看一眼两端。
But why should trading one witness for another tell us how to find either?
可是，凭什么以为把一种见证换成另一种，就告诉了我们怎样找到其中任何一种？
Swapping witnesses is not finding them.
交换见证，不等于找到见证。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: Whether two colors suffice is decided fast: walk outward, alternate, and see if two neighbors ever match.
两种颜色够不够，很快就能判定：向外走、交替着色，看有没有相邻两门同色。
Three-coloring is NP-complete, so a fast method for it exists exactly when P equals NP.
三种颜色是 NP 完全问题，所以三着色有快速算法，当且仅当 P 等于 NP。
P versus NP is open. So is this chapter's fluid question: does 3D Navier–Stokes flow always stay smooth?
P 与 NP 之问仍然开放；本章关于流体的那道题也是：三维纳维—斯托克斯流是否始终光滑？

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter twenty-six.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第二十六章
